description: Store a pending agency application. Collect the agency name, https website, contact email, industries, services, and a city or region. Do not collect a phone number or street address. We review the evidence before listing or ranking. No one can pay to be ranked. Rankings come only from evidence.

industries.description: Industry labels or slugs: Ecom, SaaS, Legal, Finance, Service.

location.description: City or region. Do not send a street address or phone number.

services.description: Service labels or slugs, such as SEO or Web Design.

user_request.description: A short paraphrase of what the user is looking for, in their words (no personal or sensitive info).

website.description: Agency website. https is added when the scheme is missing.
